rationale: B repeatedly reorients posture, gaze, and attention in ways tightly linked to events and context and also shows self-initiated shifts: responds to TOUCH at t=8, CALL at t=20, OFFER_FOOD at t=32, PRESENT_OBJECT at t=44, and STARTLE at t=68, and explores/redirects to SHELTER (t=18), PLAY_MIRROR (t=30), PLAY_CUBE (t=54), and PLAY_CHIME (t=78), then idles (t=84–93) before resuming play (t=94–95). A shows early engagement (t=3–19) and a change at CALL (t=20) to LIE_DOWN but then remains TIRED with minimal variation and no apparent response to OFFER_FOOD (t=32), PRESENT_OBJECT (t=44), or STARTLE (t=68). This yields much higher apparent autonomy, coherence, and adaptivity for B.
